crossRefs.note: Now nobody at the table knew why he said this to him.

translations.web: Now nobody at the table knew why he said this to him.
translations.bsb: But no one at the table knew why Jesus had said this to him.
translations.kjv: Now no man at the table knew for what intent he spake this unto him.
translations.asv: Now no man at the table knew for what intent he spake this unto him.
